explication: AFFiNE is a local-first workspace combining document editing, an edgeless canvas, and planning features such as databases. The main user workflow is to create or edit block-based content, arrange it in document or canvas views, and retain or synchronize workspace data. The README documents collaboration and multimodal AI; the tree identifies relevant modules, but their full wiring is not shown in the sampled source, so those links are kept broad and evidence limits are noted.
